verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a Linux package installer for self-hosted setups and scaling guidance, indicating some deployment flexibility, but the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm multi-OS/architecture support (e.g., ARM, Windows) or containerized deployment options like Docker/Helm/Kubernetes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported OS variety, CPU architectures (ARM/ARM64), and official container/Kubernetes/Helm deployment methods, plus independent confirmation of successful multi-platform self-hosting.
